ast.target: 將附件檔案下載到本機儲存庫。若停用或下載失敗，則使用外部 URL。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Property name to track which views a record belongs to. Each record will have a list of view names it appears in.
ast.target: 用來記錄資料所屬檢視的屬性名稱。每筆資料都會包含其出現的檢視名稱清單。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Adds an airtable-id property to records so that future imports can skip records that have already been imported.
ast.target: 在記錄中加入 airtable-id 屬性，讓日後匯入時可略過已匯入的記錄。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Format for the creation date prefix in filenames. Use YYYY, MM, DD for year, month, day. Leave blank for no prefix.
ast.target: 檔名中建立日期前綴的格式。使用 YYYY、MM、DD 表示年、月、日。留空則不加入前綴。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Don't include the first line in the text, since Apple Notes uses it as the title. It will still be used as the note name.
ast.target: 不要將第一行包含在內文中，因為 Apple Notes 會將它作為標題。它仍會用作筆記名稱。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: When Apple Notes has detected handwriting in drawings, include it as text before the drawing.
ast.target: 當 Apple Notes 在繪圖中偵測到手寫內容時，將其作為文字加入繪圖前方。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: How to handle notes that already exist in the vault.
ast.target: 如何處理儲存庫中已存在的筆記。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Capture state-of-mind, contact, and similar tokens in YAML when available.
ast.target: 可用時，將心情、聯絡人等標記擷取到 YAML 中。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: How to handle entries that already exist in the vault.
ast.target: 如何處理儲存庫中已存在的項目。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: When enabled, tags will be split on slashes (/) during import.
ast.target: 啟用後，匯入時會依斜線 (/) 分割標籤。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Links will be automatically updated. Enable this if the note identifier is used outside of linking between notes.
ast.target: 連結會自動更新。如果筆記識別碼也用於筆記之間連結以外的地方，請啟用此選項。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If enabled, the first row of the CSV file will be treated as column headers.
ast.target: 啟用後，CSV 檔案的第一列會視為欄位標題。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If imported, files archived in Google Keep will be tagged as archived.
ast.target: 若匯入，Google Keep 中已封存的檔案會加上 archived 標籤。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: If imported, files deleted in Google Keep will be tagged as deleted. Deleted notes will only exist in your Google export if deleted recently.
ast.target: 若匯入，Google Keep 中已刪除的檔案會加上 deleted 標籤。已刪除的筆記只有在近期刪除時才會出現在 Google 匯出檔中。

ast.name: setDesc

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Separate Notion blocks with only one line break (default is 2).

ast.name: setDesc

ast.target: 在頁面加入 notion-id 屬性，讓日後匯入時可以略過已匯入的頁面。

ast.name: setDesc

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Property name in page frontmatter to link pages to their database .base file (default: "base")
ast.target: 頁面 frontmatter 中用來將頁面連結到資料庫 .base 檔案的屬性名稱（預設：「base」）

ast.target: 同時匯入所選頁面連結的資料庫，使關聯轉換為連結而非名稱。這會匯入你未選取的頁面。
